status: Draft for owner approval. Not an approved key; it authorizes no live run.
conventions: Real 2x2 integer matrices. Eigenvectors and diagonalization are over the real numbers unless a field says otherwise.
machineChecked: tests/verification/la-eigen-key.test.mjs checks, with exact integer arithmetic: trace, determinant and characteristic polynomial; that the listed eigenvalues are exactly the real characteristic roots; every eigenpair (A v = λ v, v nonzero); eigenspace dimensions; diagonalizability over the reals, including A P = P D with det P nonzero; the R5 discriminant; and the R2 row-reduction claim. It does not check prose in key.md.

problems.role: non-symmetric, two distinct eigenvalues; eigenvalues are not its entries; row reduction changes eigenvalues
repeated eigenvalue, one line of eigenvectors, not diagonalizable
repeated eigenvalue, every nonzero vector is an eigenvector, diagonalizable

problems.note: Not diagonalizable over the reals. Over the complex numbers its eigenvalues are i and -i and it is diagonalizable; that is outside this key's scope.

problems.role: triangular and singular: eigenvalues on the diagonal, one of them 0
